_help: Manual pin corrections. They always win over automatic locations. Key by Pag-IBIG property ID (e.g. "849202509300005") for one listing, or by "sub:<SUBDIVISION>|<CITY>" exactly as Pag-IBIG writes them (e.g. "sub:SYMFONI AT NICHOLS|CEBU CITY") to fix every unit in a subdivision or building. Value: { "coords": [latitude, longitude], "note": "who/why" }.
